flags.text: Says prior research suggested that the impact of political orientation may be influenced by the broader political environment, i.e. moderation. The paper cites prior evidence that climate itself 'can influence' hesitancy and uptake (p.2, refs 19-21) and says there has been 'little research on the interaction'.
